facts.text: Evan and Sam both express gratitude for their families, describing them as a source of joy, support, and love.

evidence.quote: Yeah, Sam. Our families give us so much joy, support, and love. They're a real blessing! I don't know what I'd do without them.
Hey, Evan. My family has been my rock through everything. Don't know what I'd do without them.
For sure, Sam. That's what makes family so special. They bring so much love and happiness. It's great having their support and knowing they're always there for us.

facts.text: Evan mentions that they are having a family get-together and enjoying homemade lasagna.

evidence.quote: We're having a family get-together tonight and enjoying some homemade lasagna. Super excited!

facts.text: Sam mentions that they are also having homemade lasagna for dinner.

evidence.quote: We're keeping it light tonight, just some homemade lasagna.
